reason: My cousin in India already handles this kind of thing for me for free, and my balance is small. I would not pay a stranger's company when family can sort it out.
objection: Why pay $199 when my relative does it for nothing? Money swaps through family are what I know and trust, and I would not hand a new company my NRO details.
would_change_my_mind: If my relative could not do it, or if the paperwork and tax certificate were getting complicated and a bank rejected it, I might try the cheapest tier.
